title: Tried to replicate the most iconic game intro dialogue using AI voiceover. What do you think?
author: x_WOLVEN_x
selftext:
I'm developing a visual novel game and was considering adding AI voiceovers for the dialogue. While doing so I decided to have some fun and replicate the famous intro scene from Skyrim.

It seems the AI picked up "Stormcloaks" as "Stormclubs" lol.

replies.author: x_WOLVEN_x
replies.body: You play as a king that has to manage and save a collapsing kingdom that is facing multiple invasions and internal strife. Most of it will take place in the council room where you make decisions with your councillors. It's inspired heavily by the small council scenes in Game of Thrones :)

comments.author: rooktko
comments.body: Sounds fairy good, what app you using for this or is this home brew you made?

replies.author: x_WOLVEN_x
replies.body: I used [DialogueCraft](http://dialoguecraft.net) for the script writing and voiceover generation. They have text-to-speech but for this particular scene I used their voice changer tool. I recorded my own voice narrating the script, and then transformed it into the voice of the characters in the scene. All this was done inside the app.

comments.author: Ardalok
comments.body: The thief turned out great, you can barely hear that it's an AI.

comments.author: Brief-Number7936
comments.body: Evidently, you can teach AI to speak, but not act.
